name: no-cohorts-month-end
about: The shape production sends until Q-AD34: no cohorts at all, on the last day of the month (0 days left).

output.headline: On October 31, 2026, 2 campaigns closed out the month with $284.25 spent, 14,600 impressions, 203 clicks, and 7 leads at a cost per lead of $40.61.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet was the stronger performer: $184.50 spent, 9,120 impressions, 141 clicks, 6 leads, a cost per lead of $30.75, and a click rate of 1.5%.
Dedicated night runs brought in 1 lead at a cost per lead of $99.75, with $99.75 spent, 5,480 impressions, 62 clicks, and a click rate of 1.1%.
October 2026 closed with $8,124.50 spent on Meta, with 0 days left in the month.
No cohort data was recorded for this period, so there is nothing to review on lead progression.
